shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure occupying the full height of the field
headgear/crown-like element at the top of the figure
band of repeated motifs across the upper part of the field
justification: Both are stone monuments dominated by a single frontally-crowned anthropomorphic figure filling a tall field, with a band of repeated ornament across the upper zone, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a crisp, finely incised low relief on a flat slab showing a figure in profile with staff and pleated drapery, while B is a coarse, heavily weathered three-dimensional block whose shallow motifs (discs, curving ridges) are frontal, schematic and largely non-figural.
